entries.text: Ceannaigh agus díol; tabhair an t-airgead dom agus tóg é.
entries.gloss: Buy and sell; give me the money and take it.

entries.text: Chuaigh an phingin ón gcathair go Gleann Dá Loch.
entries.gloss: The penny went from the city to Glendalough.

entries.qa_note: Owner-reported pedagogue + native audio QA pass for D30 farraige family.

entries.text: Cén t-ainm atá ar an rí?
Cén t-ainm atá ar an áit?
entries.gloss: What is the name of the place?

entries.text: Déan cros mhór don rí le sonraí beaga.
entries.gloss: Make a big cross for the king with small details.

entries.qa_note: Owner-reported pedagogue + native audio QA pass for D30 farraige family.

entries.text: Féach ar an mballa mór cloiche.
entries.gloss: Look at the big stone wall.

entries.text: Féach ar an sean-chaisleán agus ar an mbaile nua.
entries.gloss: Look at the old castle and the new town.

entries.text: Léigh an t-inscríbhinn anois agus guí.
entries.gloss: Read the inscription now and pray.

entries.text: Seas anseo agus féach ar an gcros chloiche.
entries.gloss: Stand here and look at the stone cross.

entries.text: Tar ar ais chuig an mbá.
Tháinig an dearadh; chuaigh an phingin ón mionta.
entries.gloss: The design came; the penny went from the mint.

entries.text: Tá abhainn, bád agus bóthar anseo.
entries.gloss: There is a river, a boat and a road here.

entries.text: Tá ainm an rí ar airgead an mhargaidh agus na trádála.
entries.gloss: The king's name is on the market's silver and the trade.

entries.text: Tá ainm ar an talamh sean agus tá baile ann.
entries.gloss: There is a name on the old land and there is a town there.

entries.text: Tá an caisleán ar an gcósta.
entries.gloss: The castle is on the coast.

entries.text: Tá an chloch agus an chros anseo anois.
entries.gloss: The stone and the cross are here now.

entries.qa_note: Owner-reported pedagogue + native audio QA pass for D30 farraige family.

entries.text: Tá an long ar an bhfarraige.
entries.gloss: The ship is on the sea.
entries.qa_note: Owner-reported pedagogue + native audio QA pass for D30 farraige family.

entries.gloss: The ship is in the bay.

entries.text: Tá an margadh ar an abhainn.
entries.gloss: The market is on the river.

entries.text: Tá an t-áth anseo ar an abhainn; tá an baile ansiúd.
entries.gloss: The ford is here on the river; the town is over there.
There is a boat on the river.

entries.text: Tá cathair agus baile ag an linn dubh; tá long ar an abhainn.
entries.gloss: There is a city and town at the dark pool; a ship is on the river.

entries.text: Tá cónaí sa teach; seas sa chaisleán.
entries.gloss: There is living in the house; stand in the castle.

entries.text: Tá obair sa mhainistir agus tá mé ag foghlaim sa bhaile gach lá.
entries.gloss: There is work in the monastery and I am learning in the town every day.
There is work in the monastery.

entries.text: Tá taifead nua agam; cad atá agat? Tóg é.
entries.gloss: I have a new record; what do you have? Take it.

entries.text: Téigh ar ais go dtí an chathair.
Téigh go dtí an aghaidh; tar ar ais chuig an inscríbhinn.
entries.gloss: Go to the face; come back to the inscription.

entries.text: Téigh go Londain agus iarr freagra.
entries.gloss: Go to London and ask for an answer.
